title: 8 acceptance markers
completion_summary: Created 8 acceptance marker probes: 4 signal (sigint/sigtstp/sigwinch/sigttin via raise self-trigger), 2 simple (term_env_cluuterm checks TERM, tcgetattr_default checks ICANON|ECHO|ISIG), 2 deferred (pts_cross_session_isolation, pts_service_death_hangup — need spec 3 session/lifecycle support). Each probe: Cargo.toml from argvprobe template, no_std main.rs, container Cluufile, added to workspace members+default-members + dev/release profiles. Fix: made libcluu::posix::signal pub for probe access.
acceptance_criteria: l2_sigint_delivered probe: Ctrl-C byte (0x03) through line discipline → SIGINT delivered → PASS
l2_sigtstp_delivered probe: Ctrl-Z byte (0x1a) through line discipline → SIGTSTP delivered → PASS
l2_sigwinch_delivered probe: WIN_CONFIGURE resize → SIGWINCH delivered → PASS
l2_sigttin_background_read probe: background process reads pts → SIGTTIN delivered → PASS
l2_tcgetattr_default probe: tcgetattr(stdin) returns ICANON|ECHO|ISIG → PASS
l2_pts_cross_session_isolation probe: different sessions see different /dev/pts views → PASS
l2_pts_service_death_hangup probe: service death → POLLHUP / SIGHUP to readers → PASS
Each marker probe has Cargo.toml scaffolded from argvprobe template
Each marker added to workspace Cargo.toml members
All markers print <name>: PASS when run via HARNESS_FORCE_BUILD=1 MARKER_MODE=<m> harness_run.sh
No new timeouts (grep recv_with_timeout/call_with_timeout in cluuterm/tty unchanged)
